details.description: Mistral Large (24.02) was Mistral AI's first flagship model, launched in February 2024 with a 32,000-token context window, native function calling, and a JSON-format output mode. At launch, Mistral AI positioned it as the second-ranked model then generally available via API, behind GPT-4, based on its own benchmark comparisons. On Mistral AI's own La Plateforme, where its API name is mistral-large-2402, the model has been deprecated since November 30, 2024 and retired since June 16, 2025, replaced by Mistral Large 3. It remains available through Amazon Bedrock.
advantages: Natively fluent in English, French, Spanish, German, and Italian, per Mistral AI's launch post.
Supports native function calling and a JSON-format output mode (Mistral AI launch post).
disadvantages: Deprecated and retired on Mistral AI's own platform, replaced by Mistral Large 3 (Mistral AI documentation).
use_cases: Function calling for agentic and tool-use workflows

sources.title: Mistral Large - Amazon Bedrock model card

notes: The deprecation/retirement dates found apply to Mistral AI's own La Plateforme API (mistral-large-2402). Amazon Bedrock's own model card for this exact model (model ID mistral.mistral-large-2402-v1:0) lists its lifecycle as 'Active' with no EOL date, directly confirming that the catalog's empty deprecation_date is correct for this Bedrock-hosted entry even though Mistral AI deprecated and retired the model on its own platform. That Bedrock page also states a 4K max-output-token limit versus the catalog's 8,191; kept the catalog's value per instructions. The launch post's benchmark claims (MMLU, HellaSwag, HumanEval, GSM8K, etc.) were described qualitatively, without a readable numeric table, so evaluations were left empty rather than guessed.
